name: AGRICOR
recent: AGRICOR 近期有多项董事与主要股东权益变动申报，包括独立非执行主席 Wong Pak Yii 在公开市场多次增持股份。公司也出现董事会人事变动，涉及 Wong Pak Yii、Ng Pei Jin 与 Fu Yew Sun。最新季度业绩公告为截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间。
notable: 独立非执行主席 Wong Pak Yii 于 2025 年 9 月 22 日至 29 日期间在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 2 日出现董事会人事变动，涉及 Wong Pak Yii 与 Ng Pei Jin；8 月 29 日 Fu Yew Sun 也有董事会变动。
主要股东 Datin Cheong Kai Meng、Datuk Keh Chuan Seng 及 Frazel Group Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 11 月 11 日及 13 日申报权益变动。
risks: 董事 Wong Pak Yii 在 2025 年 9 月多次申报公开市场交易，需留意董事交易活动。
主要股东 Datin Cheong Kai Meng、Datuk Keh Chuan Seng 及 Frazel Group Sdn. Bhd. 在 2026 年 11 月连续申报权益变动，股权结构出现变化。

recent_en: AGRICOR has recently seen several director and substantial shareholder interest change filings, including multiple on-market acquisitions by Independent Non-Executive Chairman Wong Pak Yii. There were also boardroom changes involving Wong Pak Yii, Ng Pei Jin and Fu Yew Sun. The latest quarterly results announcement was for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Wong Pak Yii acquired shares in the company on multiple occasions on the open market between 22 and 29 September 2025.
The company had boardroom changes on 2 September 2026 involving Wong Pak Yii and Ng Pei Jin, and a boardroom change involving Fu Yew Sun on 29 August.
Substantial shareholders Datin Cheong Kai Meng, Datuk Keh Chuan Seng and Frazel Group Sdn. Bhd. filed interest change notices on 11 and 13 November 2026.
risks_en: Director Wong Pak Yii filed multiple open-market transaction notices in September 2025; director trading activity should be noted.

Substantial shareholders Datin Cheong Kai Meng, Datuk Keh Chuan Seng and Frazel Group Sdn. Bhd. filed consecutive interest change notices in November 2026, indicating changes in shareholding structure.
